title: Register Variation: Shifting from Colloquial Idiom to High-Formal Academic Registers
objective: Menganalisis perbedaan tajam antara bahasa percakapan informal, jurnalisme berbobot, dan register akademik kelas atas.

theory.summary: Register adalah tingkat formalitas bahasa yang disesuaikan dengan konteks komunikasi. Pada level C1, Anda dituntut menguasai minimal tiga spektrum register: (1) Colloquial/Informal—bahasa percakapan sehari-hari dengan idiom dan kontraksi; (2) Journalistic/Professional—bahasa media massa dan komunikasi bisnis yang presisi namun tetap aksesibel; (3) Academic/Formal—bahasa tulisan ilmiah dengan struktur kompleks, nominalisasi, dan diksi Latinate. Kemampuan beralih antar register dengan lancar menunjukkan kompetensi sosiolinguistik tingkat mahir, memungkinkan Anda berkomunikasi efektif dalam seminar akademik, negosiasi bisnis, hingga percakapan kasual dengan penutur asli.
rules: Colloquial Register: Gunakan contractions (I'm, we've, shouldn't), phrasal verbs (put up with, figure out), dan idiom informal (a piece of cake, hit the nail on the head). Struktur kalimat cenderung pendek dengan frequent ellipsis. Contoh: 'We've gotta figure out how to deal with this mess before it gets worse.'

Journalistic Register: Hindari contractions, pilih single-word verbs dari phrasal verbs (tolerate vs put up with, investigate vs look into), gunakan passive voice secara selektif untuk objektivitas. Struktur kalimat menengah dengan transitional phrases. Contoh: 'Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the incident, which has raised significant public concern.'

Academic Register: Terapkan nominalisasi (transform verbs menjadi nouns: discover → discovery, analyze → analysis), gunakan hedging language (arguably, potentially, to a certain extent), serta complex embeddings dengan relative clauses dan participial phrases. Hindari personal pronouns, preferensi pada passive constructions dan abstract subjects. Contoh: 'The investigation of causal relationships between socioeconomic variables and educational attainment remains a contested area within contemporary scholarship.'

commonTrap.explanation: Mahasiswa C1 sering mencampur elemen dari berbagai register dalam satu konteks, menghasilkan inkoherensi stilistik. Misalnya, menggunakan idiom colloquial dalam esai akademik atau struktur kaku formal dalam email informal kepada rekan. Kontaminasi register merusak kredibilitas penulis dan menunjukkan kurangnya kesadaran sosiolinguistik.
commonTrap.wrong: The research methodology was kinda iffy, but the results are pretty solid and really hit the nail on the head regarding our hypothesis.
commonTrap.correct: While certain methodological limitations warrant acknowledgment, the empirical findings substantiate the hypothesized correlations with considerable rigor.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat berikut yang paling tepat menerapkan register akademik formal (academic/formal register) sesuai kaidah yang diajarkan dalam modul ini — yaitu menggunakan nominalisasi, hedging language, dan menghindari unsur informal?
options: The discovery of significant correlations between dietary patterns and cognitive performance arguably necessitates further longitudinal investigation.
Researchers have figured out that eating habits are really connected to how well people think, so they should probably look into it more.
It has been found that diet is linked to cognition, and this is, like, a pretty important finding that we've gotta explore further.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Opsi pertama menggunakan nominalisasi ('discovery', 'investigation'), hedging language ('arguably'), struktur pasif/abstrak, dan diksi Latinate — semua ciri khas register akademik formal. Opsi kedua mengandung phrasal verb informal ('figured out') dan adverbia colloquial ('really'). Opsi ketiga mencampur register dengan 'like' dan 'we've gotta' yang merupakan elemen colloquial, sehingga melanggar konsistensi register akademik.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Salah satu kesalahan umum yang dibahas dalam modul ini adalah 'Register Contamination' — mencampur elemen register yang berbeda dalam satu konteks. Manakah kalimat berikut yang BEBAS dari kontaminasi register dan konsisten sebagai kalimat akademik formal?
options: The methodology was kind of problematic, yet the empirical outcomes substantiate the theoretical framework with notable precision.
Notwithstanding certain methodological constraints, the empirical outcomes substantiate the theoretical framework with notable precision.
The methodology had some issues that were a bit dodgy, but to a certain extent the results demonstrate correlational validity.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Opsi kedua sepenuhnya konsisten dalam register akademik formal: menggunakan 'notwithstanding' (konjungsi formal), nominalisasi ('constraints'), dan diksi Latinate ('substantiate', 'precision') tanpa elemen informal. Opsi pertama terkontaminasi oleh 'kind of' yang bersifat colloquial. Opsi ketiga mengandung 'a bit dodgy' yang merupakan ungkapan slang/informal Inggris, sehingga merusak konsistensi register akademik.

readinessQuestions.prompt:
Perhatikan percakapan berikut antara Prof. Richardson dan Emma. Isilah bagian "[...]" dengan respons yang paling tepat dan sesuai dengan konteks akademik formal.

Prof. Richardson: "On page seventeen, you wrote 'the data really shows' rather than 'the data demonstrate.' The adverb 'really' and the singular verb constitute register violations in academic discourse."

Emma: "[...]"
options: Oh right, my bad! I'll swap that out and make it sound fancier next time.
I appreciate the correction. Would 'the empirical findings substantiate' be more appropriate in that context?
Yeah, I guess 'really' is too casual. I'll just chuck in a bigger word and it should be fine.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Opsi kedua adalah respons yang tepat karena Emma menanggapi dengan register yang sesuai konteks akademik: sopan, formal, dan mengajukan alternatif kalimat akademik ('the empirical findings substantiate'). Opsi pertama menggunakan bahasa colloquial ('my bad', 'swap that out', 'sound fancier') yang tidak pantas dalam diskusi akademik dengan dosen. Opsi ketiga juga terlalu informal dengan 'Yeah', 'chuck in', dan 'should be fine' — menunjukkan kontaminasi register dalam konteks konsultasi akademik.

dialogue.context: Seorang mahasiswa pascasarjana (Emma) berkonsultasi dengan supervisor akademiknya (Prof. Richardson) mengenai register bahasa yang tepat untuk disertasinya. Percakapan ini menunjukkan penggunaan academic register dalam konteks advisory session.

lines.speaker: Prof. Richardson
lines.text: Emma, I've reviewed your latest chapter draft. While your argumentation is sound, I noticed certain stylistic inconsistencies that undermine the scholarly tone.
lines.translation: Emma, saya sudah menelaah draf bab terbarumu. Meski argumentasimu solid, saya menangkap inkonsistensi gaya tertentu yang melemahkan nada akademis.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Could you elucidate which specific passages require revision? I've attempted to maintain formal register throughout, but perhaps some colloquialisms slipped through.
lines.translation: Bisakah Anda menjelaskan bagian spesifik mana yang perlu revisi? Saya sudah berusaha menjaga register formal sepanjang tulisan, tapi mungkin beberapa ungkapan informal terselip.

lines.speaker: Prof. Richardson
lines.text: Precisely. On page seventeen, you wrote 'the data really shows' rather than 'the data demonstrate.' The adverb 'really' and the singular verb constitute register violations in academic discourse.
lines.translation: Tepat sekali. Di halaman tujuh belas, kamu menulis 'the data really shows' alih-alih 'the data demonstrate.' Adverbia 'really' dan kata kerja tunggal merupakan pelanggaran register dalam wacana akademik.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: I appreciate the correction. Would 'the empirical findings substantiate' be more appropriate in that context?
lines.translation: Saya menghargai koreksinya. Apakah 'the empirical findings substantiate' lebih tepat dalam konteks tersebut?

lines.speaker: Prof. Richardson
lines.text: Indeed. That formulation demonstrates appropriate nominalization and lexical sophistication. Additionally, avoid contractions entirely—'don't' should always be rendered as 'do not' in scholarly writing.
lines.translation: Benar. Formulasi itu menunjukkan nominalisasi dan kecanggihan leksikal yang tepat. Selain itu, hindari kontraksi sepenuhnya—'don't' harus selalu ditulis sebagai 'do not' dalam tulisan akademik.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Understood. I'll conduct a comprehensive register audit of the entire manuscript to eliminate such inconsistencies before the next supervision meeting.
lines.translation: Dipahami. Saya akan melakukan audit register menyeluruh pada seluruh manuskrip untuk mengeliminasi inkonsistensi semacam itu sebelum pertemuan supervisi berikutnya.

lines.speaker: Prof. Richardson
lines.text: Excellent initiative. Remember, register consistency signals intellectual rigor. Your examiners will scrutinize not merely your ideas but also your command of disciplinary conventions.
lines.translation: Inisiatif yang bagus. Ingat, konsistensi register menandakan kerigorusan intelektual. Pengujimu akan menelaah bukan hanya ide-idemu tetapi juga penguasaanmu terhadap konvensi disipliner.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: That's a valuable perspective. I'll prioritize achieving seamless stylistic coherence throughout the dissertation. Thank you for this guidance.
lines.translation: Perspektif yang berharga. Saya akan memprioritaskan pencapaian koherensi stilistik mulus di seluruh disertasi. Terima kasih atas bimbingan ini.

speakingLab.context: Mr. Khoirul akan meminta Anda menyampaikan informasi yang sama dalam tiga register berbeda: colloquial, journalistic, dan academic. Latihan ini meningkatkan fleksibilitas register Anda dalam komunikasi lisan.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we'll practice register shifting. I'll give you a scenario, and you'll express it in three different registers. Ready? Here's the situation: A company experienced a data breach affecting customer information. First, explain this to a close friend casually.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Hey, so you know that tech company I told you about? They totally got hacked last week and a bunch of customer data got leaked. It's a real mess—people are pretty upset about it.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good use of colloquial markers—'totally,' 'a bunch of,' 'real mess.' Now, imagine you're a news reporter presenting this on television. How would you phrase it?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The technology firm confirmed yesterday that unauthorized access to its systems resulted in the exposure of confidential customer information. The company has launched an internal investigation and is cooperating with cybersecurity authorities.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent—neutral tone, passive constructions, and formal vocabulary. Now the challenging part: present this as an academic discussing it in a research seminar. Use academic register.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The incident exemplifies the persistent vulnerabilities inherent in contemporary data management infrastructures. This breach necessitates critical examination of existing cybersecurity protocols and their efficacy in mitigating unauthorized intrusions into sensitive information repositories.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Superb nominalization and complex structures. You've demonstrated clear command of register variation. Let's try another scenario: telling someone about a successful job interview. Start with the colloquial version.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Guess what? I totally nailed that interview yesterday! The hiring manager seemed really impressed, and I'm pretty sure I've got a good shot at landing the position.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect enthusiasm and informal markers. Excellent work today! You're developing strong register flexibility—crucial for C1 communicative competence.

quiz.question: Which sentence demonstrates appropriate academic register? 'The study ___ significant correlations between the variables examined.'
quiz.explanation: Dalam register akademik, 'identified' adalah pilihan tepat karena merupakan single-word verb formal. 'Really found' terlalu informal dengan adverbia colloquial, sedangkan 'figured out' adalah phrasal verb yang tidak sesuai untuk tulisan ilmiah.

quiz.question: Select the sentence with correct journalistic register: 'The government ___ the proposed legislation after extensive public consultation.'
quiz.explanation: 'Scrapped' adalah pilihan jurnalistik yang tepat—formal namun aksesibel. 'Got rid of' dan 'threw out' terlalu informal untuk media berita profesional, lebih cocok untuk percakapan kasual.

quiz.question: Which phrase is most appropriate for academic writing? 'The research ___ the need for further investigation.'
quiz.explanation: 'Underscores' menunjukkan sofistikasi leksikal dan hedging yang sesuai dengan tulisan akademik. 'Shows' terlalu sederhana, sedangkan 'proves beyond doubt' terlalu absolut—akademisi biasanya menghindari klaim mutlak.

quiz.question: Identify the colloquial register sentence: 'The project deadline ___.'
options: got pushed back for a while
quiz.answer: got pushed back for a while
quiz.explanation: Kalimat ini menggunakan phrasal verb 'got pushed back' dan frasa vague 'for a while' yang khas colloquial register. Dua pilihan lain terlalu formal untuk percakapan kasual.

quiz.question: Which sentence maintains appropriate academic register? '___'
options: We can't ignore the fact that climate change is getting worse.
The escalating severity of anthropogenic climate change cannot be disregarded.
Climate change is really bad and we've got to do something about it.
quiz.answer: The escalating severity of anthropogenic climate change cannot be disregarded.
quiz.explanation: Kalimat ini menggunakan nominalisasi ('escalating severity'), diksi Latinate ('anthropogenic'), dan konstruksi pasif formal. Pilihan pertama memiliki kontraksi dan struktur terlalu sederhana, pilihan ketiga sangat colloquial dengan 'really bad' dan 'we've got to.'

quiz.question: Select the journalistic register formulation: 'Experts ___ that economic recovery will occur gradually.'
quiz.explanation: 'Anticipate' adalah pilihan jurnalistik ideal—formal namun mudah dipahami pembaca umum. 'Reckon' terlalu informal dan regional, sedangkan 'are pretty sure' terlalu colloquial untuk media berita kredibel.
